params.body:
Refs #375

- `src/tool/metadata.ts`: the Promise.all guideline becomes "Plan each step before calling: one program should gather every read, search, and probe the step needs (Promise.all, or workspace.batch for files; Promise.allSettled for optional probes), and one should make all its edits to different files. Each tool call is a round trip that resends the context. Sequence only dependent work and edits to the same file."
- `test/tool/prompt.test.ts`: fixed-prose ratchet 6,000 → 6,200 (now 6,176).
- Version 0.36.6, changelog, pinned README install.

Validated locally: check, tests, coverage, package:check.
